texts: More than 3,900 free 3D assets now answer one GET on three.ws/docs/api-reference, served from Cloud Run on @GoogleCloud. Objects, characters and motion clips sit behind a single search that anyone can call without signing in, holding a key, or paying. Every word of the query has to match; when nothing matches all of them the search retries on any of them and marks the answer relaxed: true, so a phrase never dead-ends silently.

Each hit carries a direct GLB URL, its license and its byte size. Pages run 1 to 50 results with next_offset for the next page, open CORS, cached at the edge for 5 minutes. The same join backs the free MCP catalog tools and the assets CLI, so all three surfaces answer identically.

posts: One GET searches every free 3D asset on three.ws without authentication, an API key, or payment. The catalog covers objects, characters, and motion clips. Every word of q must match somewhere; if nothing matches all of them, the search retries on any of them and sets relaxed: true. Served from Cloud Run on @GoogleCloud. three.ws/docs/api-reference

Each hit carries a direct GLB URL and its license. Limit runs 1 to 50 with a default of 12; use next_offset from the previous response for the next page. Open CORS, cached at the edge for 5 minutes. The free MCP catalog tools and the assets CLI answer identically.
